q.g: Note that you do not have to plant all markers in the same raid. As with previous quests, once you have survived the required amount of time after each plant, you can die and do the remaining objectives and extract in subsequent raids.

sh.c: The first tank is located next to the bunker northern of the resort, near the river.
The second tank is located on the road that goes from the tunnel extraction through the village.
The third tank is located on the bridge between the power station and the weather station. You can find it by following the dirt road.
